This page lists 67 Obsidian keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `obsidian.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Obsidian to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t obsidian.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/obsidian.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Obsidian.app`; if Obsidian lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Common Actions

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘X` | Cut |
| `⌘V` | Paste |
| `⌘⇧V` | Paste without formatting |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⌘⇧Z` | Redo |

## Text Formatting

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘B` | Bold |
| `⌘I` | Italic |
| `⌘K` | Insert link |
| `⌘⇧K` | Delete line (no selection) |

## Text Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥←` | Beginning of previous word |
| `⌥→` | End of next word |
| `⌘←` | Beginning of line |
| `⌘→` | End of line |
| `⌘↑` | Beginning of note |
| `⌘↓` | End of note |
| `fn↑` | Page up |
| `fn↓` | Page down |

## Text Selection

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⎋` | Simplify selection |
| `⌘A` | Select all |
| `⌥⇧←` | Select to previous word |
| `⌥⇧→` | Select to next word |
| `⌘⇧←` | Select to line start |
| `⌘⇧→` | Select to line end |
| `⌘⇧↑` | Select to note start |
| `⌘⇧↓` | Select to note end |

## Text Editing

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌫` | Delete previous word |
| `⌥⌦` | Delete next word |
| `⌘⌫` | Delete to line start |
| `⌘⌦` | Delete to line end |

## Files & Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘O` | Open Quick Switcher |
| `⌘P` | Open Command Palette |
| `⌘N` | Create new note |
| `⌘⇧N` | Create note in new pane |
| `⌘W` | Close active pane |
| `⌘E` | Toggle edit/preview mode |
| `⌘,` | Open settings |
| `⌘⌥←` | Navigate back |
| `⌘⌥→` | Navigate forward |
| `⌘F` | Find in current file |
| `⌘⇧F` | Search in all files |
| `⌘G` | Open graph view |
| `⌘⇧G` | Open local graph |

## Panes & Workspace

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘\` | Split vertically |
| `⌘⇧\` | Split horizontally |
| `⌘⌥↑` | Focus pane above |
| `⌘⌥↓` | Focus pane below |
| `⌘⌥←` | Focus pane left |
| `⌘⌥→` | Focus pane right |

## Editor

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘]` | Indent |
| `⌘[` | Outdent |
| `⌘⏎` | Follow link under cursor |
| `⌘⌥⏎` | Open link in new pane |
| `⌘D` | Delete paragraph |
| `⌘/` | Toggle comment |
| `⌘L` | Toggle checkbox |

## Headings

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘1` | Toggle heading 1 |
| `⌘2` | Toggle heading 2 |
| `⌘3` | Toggle heading 3 |
| `⌘4` | Toggle heading 4 |
| `⌘5` | Toggle heading 5 |
| `⌘6` | Toggle heading 6 |

## View

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘=` | Zoom in |
| `⌘-` | Zoom out |
| `⌘0` | Reset zoom |

## Sidebar

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⇧L` | Toggle left sidebar |
| `⌘⇧R` | Toggle right sidebar |

## Template file

The full [`obsidian.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/obsidian.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
